background: Citibank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Citigroup, with the broadest international network of any US bank, serving multinationals, institutions and consumers across around a hundred countries.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the operating bank sits well above its holding company. Capital is strong against US banks, with CET1 of 13.8% above the peer median and leverage of 7.9% in the top quarter, and LCR of 128% is also in the top quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. Flagged news in the last 90 days is heavy and dominated by the UK sanctions fine on its London branch, the newest on 11 Sep 2026.
